762.headline: Two weeks, no top prize claimed

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" has fewer top prizes left. The count changed when one top prize of $15 million was claimed last week. Unsold tickets still hold one of the original three. Check the top prize count first when you compare scratchers.

For "50th Anniversary" or any game, being late in a run is not automatically good or bad. The same numbers mean different things near the end of a run.

The numbers for "50th Anniversary" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
827.headline: A top prize was just claimed

847.body:
Before you buy "Bingo 50X", know that its $500,000 top prize is gone. The game still pays many smaller prizes, but the biggest one left is $100,000. That is a good win, but far from the advertised top prize.

The numbers for "Bingo 50X" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
847.headline: No $500,000 prize is left

891.body:
"Cash Explosion 25X" is near the end of its run, with only a small slice of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.
